sources.title: Household Debt Service Ratios
sources.supports: Required debt payments divided by disposable income.
sources.extension: Observed credits and declared income are imperfect individual-income proxies; historical installments are historical burden proxies, not current aggregate obligations.
sources.usage: Mechanism and hypothesis provenance; no external training records or labels used.

sources.title: Household Liquidity Buffers and Financial Stress
sources.author: Lydia Wang
sources.supports: Liquidity relative to income, debt net of liquid assets, and buffers against adverse cash-flow shocks.
sources.extension: Window-specific bank balances approximate liquid assets. Stress sizes and historical-window combinations are hypotheses, not calibrated forecasts.
sources.usage: Mechanism and hypothesis provenance; no external training records or labels used.

sources.title: Principles of Finance, 8.3 Loan Amortization
sources.supports: Level-payment annuity and outstanding principal under fixed monthly interest.
sources.extension: Normalize scheduled remaining principal and interest by observed income; hypothetical rate shifts do not imply the fixed loan reprices.
sources.usage: Mechanism and hypothesis provenance; no external training records or labels used.

sources.title: Credibility Theory
sources.author: R. Norberg
sources.supports: Combine individual experience and collective risk with exposure-dependent credibility.
sources.extension: Beta-binomial late-payment posterior, uncertainty and exposure weight; concentration grid is predeclared. Cohort rates use context rows only.
sources.usage: Mechanism and hypothesis provenance; no external training records or labels used.

sources.title: Explainable AI for Credit Assessment in Banks
sources.authors: P. D. de Lange; B. Melsom; Christian Bakke Vennerod; Sjur Westgaard
sources.journal: Journal of Risk and Financial Management
sources.supports: Credit-balance volatility and available credit contributed to default prediction in one unsecured-consumer-loan dataset.
sources.extension: Temporal changes and normalized dispersion of account and bureau measures are proposed extensions, not results established for this competition.
sources.usage: Mechanism and hypothesis provenance; no external training records or labels used.

sources.title: BaggingClassifier documentation
sources.extension: Semantic blocks with shared anchors and inner-only ensemble selection for Kumo; improvement is unproven.
sources.usage: Mechanism and hypothesis provenance; no external training records or labels used.

limits: Source evidence motivates mechanisms. Grid sizes, feature windows and stress sizes are our hypotheses; none of the sources establishes an improvement in this competition.
